status: PREPARED BY S12 (WP14, the Vodacom plan), NOT APPLIED. S15 writes `manifest` below over public/manifest.json in the flip's commit, with the sw.js CACHE_NAME bump, after replacing every placeholder and drawing every file listed in `toBeDrawn`. Until then public/manifest.json is unchanged: one file for every visitor, so it cannot change before the flip. Guarded by test:install-invite §10.
decisions: Point for Ali 10 — ACCEPTED BY ALI, 2026-10-14: the phone's home-screen shortcuts (Maswali, Tiketi zangu) and the app's name change at launch, with a new screenshot after launch.

S12 Open point 24: the shortcuts are Maswali (/) and Tiketi zangu (/positions), and Weka pesa (/wallet/deposit) is kept; the Wallet shortcut goes. Their names are the journey's own words, read from the dictionary (journey.tabQuestions, journey.tabTickets, journey.depositAction), never written here.

placeholders.{{S11_TAGLINE}}: S11 (SJ-20) owns the tagline the app's name carries. It is never invented here: S15 replaces this token with S11's approved words, and the guard refuses a manifest that still holds it once applied.

toBeDrawn.picture: the questions tab's glyph (`questionCircle`, the journey tab bar)
toBeDrawn.why: a new picture takes a new name: /icons/* is served one-year immutable (next.config.ts IMMUTABLE_STATIC_SOURCES), so a redrawn shortcut-markets.png would stay stale on every phone that cached it

toBeDrawn.picture: the tickets tab's glyph (`ticket`, the journey tab bar)
toBeDrawn.why: a new shortcut with a new picture; drawn by hand like the other shortcut-*.png — build:brand never writes them (DESIGN_AUTHORITY §B1a)

toBeCaptured.when: after the flip (S15/S16), never before: the new journey in Swahili at 390×844, signed out, with no chat bubble over a figure (MOBILE-VISUAL D55). It takes a new name because /screenshots/* is one-year immutable; it is added to `manifest.screenshots` in the commit that adds the file.

notes: The old narrow screenshot (/screenshots/markets-narrow.png: the retired journey, in English — MOBILE-VISUAL D55) leaves the manifest at the flip; its successor is listed in `toBeCaptured` and joins the manifest only once it exists. The file itself stays on disk (an immutable URL a phone may still hold).

The wide screenshot is the brand image /og/og-1200x630.png. /og/* is one-year immutable as well (next.config.ts): if S11 redraws that picture with the tagline, it takes a NEW file name, and this entry — and the root layout's openGraph image — move with it.
"lang" stays "en", exactly as today: it is Ali's choice (one manifest serves every language; MOBILE-VISUAL D55 asks for "sw", the product's default).
The wide screenshot's label carries the tagline placeholder as the name does: today both carry the slogan the flip retires.
Every other member is today's, byte for byte: the app's description, colours, orientation, categories and icons.
